channel.title: Animal Save Movement - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Animal Save Movement (thesavemovement.org)

item.title: Animals Rescued At Vigils By Animal Save Movement Activists - Animal Save Movement
item.description: Activists bear witness and attend vigils for chickens, cows, pigs, turkeys, lambs, fish, and many other species with Animal Save Movement chapters around the world. The goal is to create a nonviolent, eco-vegan society, and it’s also a wonderful way to meet other activists, vegans, or those curious about veganism and helping our earth.

item.title: To go where the suffering takes place - Animal Save Movement
item.description: Two million bobby calves are killed every year during dairy calf-killing season in New Zealand

item.title: From Animal Rescues To Vegan Outreach: Animal Save Movement’s Goals For 2025 - Animal Save Movement
item.description: 2024 was a hugely successful year for Animal Save Movement (ASM). From a movement that began in 2010 with Toronto Pig Save, we have big goals for 2025. We will be expanding globally with our love-based and nonviolent advocacy that is rooted in the philosophies of Tolstoy and Gandhi. Our mission is to end animal exploitation and suffering and create a fair and sustainable vegan world for the animals, the planet, and health.

item.title: The Real Cost Of Eating Chicken Eggs And Sustainable Alternatives - Animal Save Movement
item.description: Plant Based Treaty Los Angeles held a plant-based induction cooktop demo with the LA Neighborhood Council Sustainability Alliance. Attendees were so excited to try Eat Just eggs made from plants and see how easy it is to prepare! Special thanks to City Campaigner Joey Gaber for facilitating this demo with City Campaigner Sam Lau.

item.title: The Importance Of Exercise And Tips On Building Muscle (Blog Series Featuring Dr. Brooke Goldner and Thomas Tadlock) - Animal Save Movement
item.description: Why is exercise important? Thomas Tadlock, who has a master's degree in exercise science and health promotion, explains the importance of keeping your body moving. In their article about the benefits of regular physical activity they state that exercise can combat health conditions and diseases, improve mood, boost energy, and promote better sleep.

item.title: Ten Plant Based Treaty Celebrity Endorsers Making A Difference - Animal Save Movement
item.description: These ten celebrities are forces to be reckoned with from all walks of life with one common theme. They have all endorsed the Plant Based Treaty and believe in putting food systems at the heart of combatting the climate crisis, and recognize we must stop the widespread degradation of critical ecosystems caused by animal agriculture.

item.title: Did You Know Octopus Have Three Hearts And Blue Blood? These Magnificent Marine Mollusks Are Being Exploited And Need Our Help - Animal Save Movement
item.description: Octopuses are sentient beings that want to live in freedom and deserve so much better than a life in captivity, whether it’s on display in a tank or stuck on a factory farm. Keep reading to learn how incredible these creatures are and why they need our help.

item.title: They are sentient beings, just like us. - Animal Save Movement
item.description: Together with her son, who was 12 years old, Louise went vegan 18 years ago. She describes how much it has meant for her to do this with her son and have his support and love. Louise Jorgensen has organized Toronto Cow Save vigils for ten years at the slaughterhouse St. Helen’s Meat Packers in Toronto.

item.title: Help Us Ban Violent Children's Hunting in Aotearoa New Zealand - Animal Save Movement
item.description: Animal Save Movement is calling on the New Zealand Government to ban the involvement of children in animal hunting competitions and activities throughout Aotearoa New Zealand. The torture and abuse of animals has no place in fundraisers or competitions, especially with children involved. Animal Save Movement is calling to take action that ensures legislative change.
